long.live: Live: changes from other devices show up here right away.
long.checking: Checking the connection to the server…
long.offline: No internet. The app goes live again when the connection is back.
long.unreachable: The server can’t be reached. The app will try again shortly.
long.notConfigured: The server isn’t set up yet, so there is no data.

commandBar.title: Search and go
commandBar.placeholder: Type where to go or what to do…
commandBar.comingSoon: Searching by order number, price and place is coming here soon.

building.title: This screen is still being built

dashboard.subtitle: What’s due, what money is expected and what’s being delivered, at a glance.
dashboard.upcoming: Money waiting to be paid, this month’s bills and payments, today’s deliveries and who did what will show here.

orders.subtitle: Challans, bill, summary and datasheet are generated from each order.
orders.upcoming: Every order will be listed here with its status, challan count and bill total, with search and filters.

newOrder.subtitle: Drop the order in from wherever it came. The system drafts it; you check and confirm.
newOrder.upcoming: Orders will start from an Excel file, a PDF or photo, a phone call, or page by page as before.

receivables.subtitle: Every ৳100 billed arrives as ৳84 · the deduction rate is a client setting
receivables.upcoming: Paste a bank SMS here to match a payment, and see which bills are unpaid and for how long.

clients.subtitle: Organisation → project; each project has its own address, POs and deduction rule
clients.upcoming: Each client’s billing this fiscal year, unpaid amount and average days to pay will be here.

locations.subtitle: The English name clients write and the Bangla name on the datasheet, kept together
locations.upcoming: Locations will be listed here with their union, spelling variants and delivery counts.

packages.subtitle: Everyone knows a package by its price, so the price leads
packages.upcoming: The new package list will be here, searchable by price, with an Excel import for the whole list.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: There is no page at this address
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the page has moved.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: Try again; if it keeps happening, reload the app.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of the app is ready
pwa.updateHint: Finish what you’re doing, then reload.

gallery.intro: Every colour, type style and component of the app in one place. Switch the theme and language at the top, and open it on a phone too.

colors.title: Colour
colors.body: The hotel’s logo blue is the brand, turmeric marks work in progress, and status colours stand apart, always with an icon or words. Light and dark are each designed on their own, and all text passes AA contrast.

type.title: Type
type.body: Anek Bangla for headings and figures, Hind Siliguri for text, IBM Plex Mono for codes. Columns of figures use equal-width digits.
type.sampleBody: Challans, bill, summary and datasheet are generated from each order. The delivery boys get a link on their phones.
type.width: Width axis: one face, four widths

icons.title: Icons
icons.body: One set of stroke icons everywhere (Lucide) at a 1.75 stroke, named by what they mean.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.body: One main action per screen gets the blue button. Destructive actions ask for a second press. Buttons grow on touch screens.
buttons.confirmHint: The first press asks; it resets by itself after a few seconds.

forms.title: Forms
forms.body: Every field has a label, help where needed, and says how to fix a mistake. Field edges are dark enough to find at a glance.
forms.poHint: e.g. PBD-2794325; bank SMS are matched by it
forms.quantityError: Enter a number such as 26 or 10+2
forms.smsHint: Paste the whole SMS, with the BDT amount and the PBD number
forms.smsSample: BDT 86200.80 has been credited to your a/c through EFT, PBD2781190, on 08-OCT-26.

chips.title: Chips, tags and statuses
chips.body: Chips filter, tags label, and every status has its own colour, icon and words.

cards.title: Cards and notes
cards.body: Cards only where one subject belongs together, not everywhere. On a package card the price leads.
cards.panelSubtitle: Days since the bill was issued
cards.panelBody: The standard panel: surface with a hairline edge, holding one chart or list.
cards.insetBody: A quieter group inside a panel, without an edge.

notes.info: The deduction rate comes from the client’s settings. This panel is never printed.
notes.locked: Issued 15/09/2026 and locked. A change creates a revised bill.
notes.warning: Bill quantities and challan totals differ for 2 packages.
notes.error: No amount or PO number was found in the SMS.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.body: The underline slides to the chosen tab. Arrow keys move between tabs.
tabs.label: Order sections

panels.schedule: Rows of date × location, a price column per package, and totals.
panels.challans: Every challan, signed copies returned, and the A4 preview.
panels.bill: The bill’s A4 preview, the deduction panel, and issue and lock.
panels.datasheet: The Bangla datasheet for the delivery boys.
panels.history: Who did what to this order, and when.

overlays.title: Dialogs, sheets and toasts
overlays.body: Dialogs for short decisions, sheets slide up on phones, and toasts say what happened, with progress for long jobs.
overlays.cancelBody: Its challans and datasheet can no longer be printed. The order stays in the history.
overlays.dialogHint: Esc or a press outside closes it.
overlays.quantityHint: You can write a sum, e.g. 10+2
overlays.sheetHint: Big fields for phones; drag the handle down to close.
overlays.errorBody: Check the internet connection and try again.
overlays.toastHint: A long job’s toast stays until the job is done. Swipe right or press ✕ to dismiss.

states.title: Loading and empty states
states.body: Loading shows the shape of the page, not a spinner. Empty states say what happened and what to do next.
states.inPanelHint: Small, when a search finds nothing
states.noResultsBody: Try another price, or add a new package.
states.emptyBody: Add the first order: from an Excel file, a PDF, a photo, or by hand.
states.errorBody: The server couldn’t be reached. Try again in a moment.
states.offlineBody: Pages opened before can still be seen. Saving anything new needs a connection.

table.title: Tables
table.body: Press a column to sort; money lines up on the right. On phones each row becomes a card. Long lists only draw what is on screen.
table.longHint: Scroll it: even thousands of rows stay smooth.

figures.title: Figures and progress
figures.body: Headline figures count up beside a small trend line. The running month is incomplete, so its point is hollow. Progress shows as meters and steps.
figures.sparklineHint: The last point is the current period; hollow means the month is still running.

motion.title: Motion
motion.body: Short and purposeful: screens rise in, cards arrive one by one, a change from another device glows once. Everything stays still if the device asks for reduced motion.
motion.realtimeHint: The row glows briefly when news arrives
